caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate pitcher, rendered in grayscale pencil on an off-white or yellowed paper background. The pitcher features a curving, wide spout at the top, a highly decorative handle with detailed scrollwork, and a bulbous, faceted body that narrows towards the neck before flaring at the base. The base of the pitcher is elevated by three intricately shaped feet, each with a stylized, ornamental leaf motif. Shadows beneath the feet suggest the object is resting on a flat surface. There are faint smudges and stains visible on the paper, as well as light pencil marks suggesting texture and highlights on the pitcher’s surface. On the left side of the paper beneath the pitcher are inscriptions in small, capital letters with details about the object, though some letters are faded. The pitcher is the sole object in the center composition, with no other items present.
title: Pewter Pitcher
